policy.core: Objectives 1.1 through 1.4, their vocabulary, and their factual cases trace to Chapter 1 of the supplied textbook.
policy.supplement: Applications 1.5, 1.6 and 1.7 are explicitly labeled supplements, not textbook learning objectives. 1.5 applies the Porter works cited by Chapter 1. 1.6 gathers the AI material Chapter 1 already carries and adds a method for deciding where AI belongs in a workflow. 1.7 restates definitions the chapter gives as executable functions; it introduces no new claims about the subject matter.
policy.hypotheticals: Practice situations are signposted as hypothetical. They may supply qualitative conditions needed for reasoning, but may not invent a real company, purport to report a real-world statistic, or blur a scenario assumption into a factual claim.
policy.currentLaw: Statements about current privacy law use official regulator or statutory sources and are framed by jurisdiction rather than as universal rules.
